# Lincah Rent Car

> Lincah Rent Car is a car rental company operating in Batam (Riau Islands) and Palembang (South Sumatra), Indonesia. It provides self-drive (lepas kunci) and chauffeur (dengan supir) car rental with direct vehicle handover at airports, ferry terminals, railway stations, ports, and hotels.

Lincah Rent Car serves two operational cities: **Batam** (flagship city, serving Singapore and Malaysia visitors via ferry terminals) and **Palembang** (serving Sultan Mahmud Badaruddin II Airport, Kertapati Station, and Tanjung Api-Api Port).

Vehicle handover is available at major arrival hubs, including Hang Nadim Airport (Batam), Harbour Bay Ferry Terminal, Batam Centre Ferry Terminal, Sekupang Ferry Terminal, SMB II Airport (Palembang), Kertapati Railway Station, and Tanjung Api-Api Port.

All rental rates are quoted in Indonesian Rupiah (IDR) with estimated conversions to SGD and MYR shown for international visitors. The company operates 24 hours every day.

Contact: WhatsApp +6281373703639 (0813-7370-3639).
Head office (Batam): Jln. Jend Sudirman Komp. Ruko Mega Legenda 2 Blok B2 No.7 Baloi Permai, Batam, Kepri 29431.
Branch office (Palembang): Lorong Tj. Burung Utama, Bukit Lama, Kec. Ilir Bar. I, Kota Palembang, Sumatera Selatan 30139.

## Services

- [Car Rental with Driver](https://lincahrentcar.com/layanan/dengan-supir/): Chauffeur service with 12-hour daily operation and professional local drivers.
- [Self-Drive Car Rental](https://lincahrentcar.com/layanan/lepas-kunci/): 24-hour self-drive rental for privacy and flexibility.
- [Airport & Ferry Terminal Transfer](https://lincahrentcar.com/layanan/antar-jemput-bandara-pelabuhan/): Punctual pickup and drop-off at airports, ferry terminals, and stations.
- [Weekly Car Rental](https://lincahrentcar.com/layanan/sewa-mingguan/): Discounted 7-day rental packages.
- [Monthly & Corporate Rental](https://lincahrentcar.com/layanan/sewa-bulanan/): Long-term fleet lease for companies and projects.

- [Toyota Innova Reborn](https://lincahrentcar.com/mobil/innova-reborn/): Medium MPV, 7 seats, 4 luggage. IDR 500,000 self-drive / IDR 750,000 with driver per day.
- [Toyota Avanza](https://lincahrentcar.com/mobil/toyota-avanza/): Family MPV, 7 seats. IDR 300,000 self-drive / IDR 500,000 with driver per day.
- [Toyota Hiace Commuter](https://lincahrentcar.com/mobil/hiace-commuter/): 15-seat tour van, driver required. IDR 1,000,000 per day.

## Pickup Hubs Batam

- [Hang Nadim Airport](https://lincahrentcar.com/lokasi/hang-nadim/): Batam international airport (BTH), 15 to 20 minutes handover.
- [Batam Centre Ferry Terminal](https://lincahrentcar.com/lokasi/batam-centre/): Main ferry terminal near Mega Mall Batam Centre.
- [Harbour Bay Ferry Terminal](https://lincahrentcar.com/lokasi/harbour-bay/): Ferry gateway from HarbourFront Singapore.
- [Sekupang Ferry Terminal](https://lincahrentcar.com/lokasi/sekupang/): Domestic ferry and HarbourFront access.
- [Telaga Punggur Port](https://lincahrentcar.com/lokasi/punggur/): Ro-Ro access to Tanjung Pinang and Bintan.
- [Mega Legenda 2](https://lincahrentcar.com/lokasi/mega-legenda/): Head office complex at Baloi Permai.
- [Batu Aji & Batamindo Industrial Park](https://lincahrentcar.com/lokasi/batu-aji/): Industrial area and factory pickup hub.

## Pickup Hubs Palembang

- [SMB II Airport](https://lincahrentcar.com/lokasi/bandara-smb2-palembang/): Sultan Mahmud Badaruddin II International Airport (PLM), 15 to 20 minutes handover.
- [Tanjung Api-Api Port](https://lincahrentcar.com/lokasi/pelabuhan-tanjung-api-api/): Ferry Ro-Ro port for arrivals from Bangka Island.
- [Kertapati Station & LRT](https://lincahrentcar.com/lokasi/stasiun-kertapati-lrt-palembang/): Railway station and LRT corridor pickup.
- [City Center & Jl. Sudirman](https://lincahrentcar.com/lokasi/pusat-kota-sudirman-palembang/): Hotel and business district handover.
- [R. Sukamto & PTC Mall](https://lincahrentcar.com/lokasi/ptc-mall-r-sukamto-palembang/): Commercial and hotel district in Palembang.
- [Jakabaring Sport City](https://lincahrentcar.com/lokasi/jakabaring-sport-city-palembang/): Sport complex, OPI Mall, and stadium area.

## Rental Requirements

Self-drive renters from outside the city must provide a photo of a national ID (KTP) or passport, a valid driving licence (SIM A, IDP, or SG/MY licence), a return ticket or hotel booking, and an active social media profile for verification.
